primary_question: As of the run's UTC date, what is the latest stable Python release and its release date?
intended_decision: Report the latest stable CPython release version and official release date for operator verification.
constraints: hard_requirement:Distinguish stable releases from prereleases (alpha, beta, rc).
hard_requirement:Cite the official Python release or download page on python.org as primary evidence.
hard_requirement:Report uncertainty if official pages disagree or cannot be read.
hard_requirement:Allowed evidence hostnames only: python.org, www.python.org, docs.python.org.
hard_requirement:DuckDuckGo HTML search is discovery transport only; not an evidence domain.
exclusions: third-party release trackers as sole authority
